title: `warp_mouse()` not moving cursor in Linux Wayland
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible on Godot 4.3 stable and 4.4 stable on Linux. In windows it is not reproducible

### System information

Fedora Linux 42 Wayland, Fedora Linux 41 Wayland

### Issue description

I’ve been trying to create a right stick moue control in godot and it seems the warp_mouse function is not working. None of them, coming from get_window, get_viewport, Input, seems to work.

The interesting thing is the mouse position seems to be updated internally but the mouse cursor is not moving at all in the screen (checked using print of mouse position before and after the warp_mouse call).

I opened a thread in godot forum initially: https://forum.godotengine.org/t/cant-make-warp-mouse-to-move-the-mouse-cursor/104482 but seemed it worked for others, so I was testing this in other versions of godot/OS.

### Steps to reproduce

To reproduce just add the following screen to a root node in any scene. (Thanks @mrcdk for the simpler version)

```gdscript
extends Node


func _ready() -> void:
	Input.mouse_mode = Input.MOUSE_MODE_CONFINED


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	var vector = Input.get_vector(&"ui_left", &"ui_right", &"ui_up", &"ui_down")
	var pos = get_window().get_mouse_position() + vector * 100 * delta
	Input.warp_mouse(pos)
```

The mouse cursor should move using arrow keys but it does not move.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mouse_test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19133964/mouse_test.zip)
